name: TEN-F0 tennis feature baseline
summary: Baseline tennis feature cartridge consumed by TEN-T0. It documents source coverage and model-ready feature expectations without changing feature math.
keyImprovements: Gives the tennis feature layer a canonical sport-prefixed cartridge identity.
Keeps rankings, recent form, market lines, Kalshi context, and weather coverage expectations in one feature contract.
Makes feature coverage auditable separately from TEN-T0 winner and market-lane decisions.

keyMetrics.label: Required source groups
keyMetrics.details: Scoreboard, rankings, Flashscore, SofaScore, FanDuel, Kalshi, and weather.

keyMetrics.label: Training snapshot
keyMetrics.details: Locked runs must store run-scoped training rows or a training-row hash.

notes: TEN-F0 is a component cartridge, not a standalone prediction model.
Future feature changes should become TEN-F1+ and compare downstream TEN-T* output against the TEN-T0 golden slate.
Missing source coverage should fail health checks before prediction publishing.
